findings.description: The algorithm does not define the fail-closed outcome when visible depth cannot fully cover `OrderQty`, leaving WAP/slippage undefined for an unpriceable order.

evidence.quote: 2. Compute the Weighted Avg Price (WAP) for `OrderQty`.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a rule that if cumulative displayed depth on the required side is less than `OrderQty`, LiquidityGate MUST reject before dispatch with an explicit reason and matching AT.

findings.description: The staleness pre-check omits replace-order placement from the fallback branch, even though the normative rule and later ATs require replace intents to use the same fallback/no-price handling.

evidence.quote: reject per the rules above (OPEN → `Rejected(LiquidityGateNoL2)`; CLOSE/HEDGE → §3.1 fallback).

findings.proposed_fix: Change the step-0 parenthetical to include replace in the fallback branch: `CLOSE/HEDGE/replace → §3.1 fallback`.
